mentions.name: dictum
mentions.description: A tool for tracking decisions rather than issues, so that the developer and their coding AI assistant stay aligned with what was decided previously. Currently being dogfooded to evaluate whether it helps in the long term.
mentions.problem: Coding AI assistants can drift out of alignment with decisions the developer has made previously.
